Players Committee card image of [[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V)]] (the same image re-uploaded turned 90°; part of that version, not a separate one; no errata mark), printing: Light Side: “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” Dark Side: “If Leia is about to be lost from a Death Star site, imprison her here instead (even if inactive).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/death_star_detention_block_corridor.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/death_star_detention_block_corridor.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
